subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick 15-minute walkthrough?
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@brightly.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick 15-minute walkthrough?

Hi Alicia,

Congrats on getting Brightly.ai up and running — I noticed your project crossed our 50k token usage threshold this morning (nice work!). We usually offer a short 15-minute walkthrough for teams at this stage to show a couple quick ops tips (KV caching, batching settings) and answer any immediate questions so you can avoid throttles as you scale.

Would you be open to a 15-minute session this week? A couple short options:
- Tue Oct 13, 11:00–11:15am PT
- Wed Oct 14, 3:00–3:15pm PT

If neither works, send over two times that do and we’ll adapt. I can cover the walkthrough myself or put one of our SDR/solutions engineers on the call depending on what you prefer.

I attached a very short runbook and a one-pager that we run through in this session so you know what to expect.

Best,
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
Attachments: runbook_quickstart.pdf (1.2MB), demo-one-pager.pdf (450KB)

Quick note: we have a couple of overlapping deadlines this week, so the Tue/Wed windows are tight. I can do Thu Oct 15 between 9:30–10:00am PT or Fri Oct 16 after 2pm PT. If it helps, cc'ing our procurement lead Lydia (lydia@brightly.ai) — she may want the call recorded for internal ops.

Also curious if you can cover best-practice config for cost controls (batching + token limits) — that’s the immediate ask from our infra lead.

Thanks,

Quick internal — Alicia from Brightly.ai just hit 50k tokens and asked for a short session. She prefers Thu 10/15 9:30–10:00am PT or Fri after 2pm PT. She specifically wants cost-control best practices (batching, token caps) and a short ops checklist.

Ben — any chance you can lead Thu 9:30am PT? If not, Mina can own. I attached the short runbook and the demo one-pager; please skim the one-pager for 2–3 bullets to surface.

Proposed plan: 15 minutes total — 8 minutes demo/ops, 4 minutes Q&A, 3 minutes next steps (billing/procurement). I’ll handle calendar invite and follow-up notes.

— Soojin

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Welcome to Redwood — quick 15-minute walkthrough?

I can take Thu 10/15 9:30am PT. Quick ask — can you drop 3 bullets I should call out for cost controls? I’ll highlight them at the top of the session and leave a copied checklist in the follow-up.

Suggested bullets to call out (draft):
- Enable adaptive batching for your high-throughput endpoints (saves ~25% token cost for typical workloads)
- Set a per-request token cap and use prefix caching for repeated prompts
- Pin a quantized model variant for test->prod to reduce p99 latency and cost variance

I’ll attach a one-pager I usually use for these calls.

— Ben
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
Attachments: ben-demo-cheatsheet.pdf

See you Thu,
Soojin
